scope.rolling_origin: within-origin serial dependence plus across-origin dependence of origin-level means

requirements: Retain the complete loss-differential vector before dependence characterization.
Prespecify the maximum lag used by the dependence characterization.
Treat the resulting dependence profile as an input to method selection, not as a result-dependent reason to choose a more favorable method.
Reject non-finite or structurally inconsistent dependence profiles.
